meta.method: Google Maps walking directions (mode=walking), retrieved 2026-11-17 via direct directions URL.
meta.target_venue: The Venetian Poker Room (Palazzo level 2) — the shared tournament venue for the DSE IV series.
meta.rule: A hotel is usable for an 8 AM–close day only if the walk from the lobby to the Venetian poker room can be completed inside 30 minutes.
meta.caveat: Google Maps walking durations are Google's own published estimates and run optimistic (they assume a brisk pace and under-weight Strip crossings/traffic signals). The route distance in miles is the more reliable figure and is stored alongside. Each row links the exact Google Maps directions URL used, so a reader can re-run it.
meta.previous_state: Every 'minutes' cell was null and flagged unverified (walk_policy.verified_minutes_source stated the build sandbox had no Google/Apple Maps access). This file closes that gap with measured values. Reconciled 2026-11-17T23:05Z: an earlier capture published on this site carried pace-impossible short durations (e.g. ARIA 11 min for 1.4 mi, Wynn 4 min for 0.5 mi — driving times). Every minutes/distance/via cell now holds the measured Google Maps walking capture of 2026-11-17T22:23:55Z, identical to data/walks.json and data/walk-measurements.json; the short set is retained only inside data/walk-measurements.json's comparison block, labelled not-for-publication.
